text:
paul_csm: Heads-up  Velora QBR next Wed 10am PT. Finance flagged a surprise embed spike + onboarding gaps. Need: token econ snapshot, onboarding status, renewal risks, and a short mitigation plan. Who owns the numbers + slide?

jenny_cs: I got the slide. Will compile 7/30/90 cohorts and a savings delta table (status_quo vs optimized).

eric_se: FYI their latest release added a background reindex that fans out many embed calls. I can pull top callers and recommend throttles/caching.

watchdog_bot: infra-alert: account=velora daily_tokens=2.3M @2026-07-14T04:12:00Z  budget_alert auto-created & tagged #cs-escalations.

mona_finops: Finance note: projected monthly (status_quo) ~= $5.6k. A modest Dedicated commit (3mo) could bring it to ~$4.2k/mo, but requires onboarding ops support. Need sensitivity scenarios.

jenny_cs: Early draft numbers: baseline tokens/month ~= 8.9M; MoM trend +42%. Quick model: prefix KV cache (-22% tokens), batching small embed jobs (-11%), dedupe for fanouts (-8%). Combined conservative saving ~35%.

eric_se: Route query I ran for top callers:```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) tokens, count(*) calls
FROM usage
WHERE account='velora' AND time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

jenny_cs: Proposed one-slide playbook for the QBR: 1) Immediate: enable prefix_kv for conversation + history routes and add soft budget alert at 1.4M/day; 2) 3-7 days: enable 150-200ms batching for bulk embed jobs; 3) 2-4 weeks: pilot quantized rerank on mirror traffic; 4) 30-day: propose 3mo dedicated commit + onboarding credits. Include an A/B pilot (25% traffic) to show measured token drop.

eric_se: Small ops snippet to include in appendix:```yaml
routes:
  - name: /v1/embeddings/bulk
    cache: prefix_kv
    cache_ttl: 1800
    batching:
      enabled: true
      max_delay_ms: 200
    dedupe: true
```

watchdog_bot: note: temporary alert rule will mute escalation for 48h if preflight A/B pilot is running (tag: #cs-qbr-pilot).

mona_finops: I'll prepare two scenarios: status_quo and optimized (caching+batching+commit). Also show credits_left vs days_to_exhaustion under both.

jenny_cs: Action items: (1) @jenny_cs deliver forecast CSV + one-slide by EOD tomorrow; (2) @eric_se attach top-10 route export + estimated % savings and latency delta; (3) @mona_finops assemble commit tiers + sensitivity table; (4) @paul_csm draft renewal ask language and customer value quote.

paul_csm: I'll reach out to the customer's PM for a short quote about product impact; even 1-2 lines helps the execs.

eric_se: I'll include expected risks: caching correctness for session-scoped history, and potential +20-50ms tail on batched paths. Will include rollback steps.

mona_finops: I'll add a simple ROI calc: %cost_reduction * projected_12mo_spend and show break-even for the 3mo commit.

jenny_cs: Also proposing an A/B metric: tokens_per_conversation and error_rate. If tokens_per_conversation drops >=20% with no error increase, recommend immediate rollout.

paul_csm: Good. Let's aim to flip this into a renewal win by showing a measurable pilot and a low-friction commit option. Dry-run Tue 9am PT. Thx all :thumbsup:

(ends)
